scope: all tracked *.rs files in Cargo workspace members, one owner each (longest manifest directory); not the code compiled into any one binary
counting_policy: physical LOC: every line including comments and blanks; a final unterminated line counts as one line
breakdown_policy: verification = files under tests/, benches/, examples/, fuzz/ (kind by directory); files declared by `mod x;` under #[cfg(test)] or #[cfg(kani)] and everything beneath them; and, inside any other file, items carrying #[cfg(test)], #[cfg(kani)], #[test], or #[kani::proof] (an any()/all() predicate containing test or kani counts; a file-level #![cfg(test)] makes the whole file verification), measured by a brace scanner that honors comments and literals (rustscan.py). cfg(not(test)) is production. Unclassifiable lines count as production.
exclusions: tracked non-.rs files (toml: 37, md: 30, gitignore: 6, sh: 4, yml: 4, dict: 4, json: 3, svg: 3)
